svg.title: The canteen and the service yard, 13.40
svg.desc: A hospital canteen seen from the service yard with a steam counter, a tray rail, a salad bar, vending machines, a cold cabinet and a delivery van at the back.

g.text: The canteen and the service yard, 13.40
Twelve things to find. Four of them were not in a hospital canteen in 1994.
four menus, two of them fresh
